Dear Laura,
I hope this email finds you well.
Upon further investigation, we identified an issue related to communication controller unit that was with a internal error when the ticket was initially opened.
I'm pleased to inform you that this issue was successfully resolved by performing a reboot of the controller. Since this action, I have thoroughly monitored the system, and I have not detected any further faults or anomalies in the charger's performance. It appears to be operating as expected.
To ensure everything is fully satisfactory on your end, could you please confirm if the charger is now functioning correctly and if you are no longer experiencing any issues?
Once we receive your confirmation that all is well, I will proceed to formally close this support ticket.
Thank you for your continued patience and cooperation.
With best regards,
